skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The gear Orchid changed into while hunting “monsters” in the Bubbly Realm.
Based on a Kamura Village design with adjustments of her own, it is tailored to her in every sense.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Orchid still hasn't come to like hunting.
But she is at least willing to admit that, wearing this gear, she feels a little freer.
